caption: The drawing features a single garment, a short, open-front jacket with rounded edges and wide sleeves. The jacket is predominantly pink in color, with a decorative trim in gold or yellow along the edges and across the sleeves. The decorative trim shows geometric and linear patterns that radiate outward from the front opening and form a zigzag and looped band near the sleeve hems. The inside of the jacket is illustrated in a light blue or grey shade, visible along the neckline. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color with no additional objects, patterns, or figures present. Near the bottom right corner, the name "Syrena Jurançon" is written in small, neat text.
